# CLI GUI Human Agent Equality

## Principle
EMA should be designed around a shared workspace where:
- humans can use GUI and CLI
- agents can use GUI and CLI where appropriate
- no important object is trapped in one surface
- no critical workflow is exclusive to one actor type

## Practical meaning
- a human can review a code session in GUI or inspect via CLI
- an agent can query graph knowledge or workstreams via CLI and potentially render/drive GUI surfaces indirectly
- a workstream remains the same workstream regardless of access path
- approvals, review state, bindings, chronicle, and memory are shared truth
